title: Permission To Think Has Been Revoked
description:
That mind of yours has been running wild for far too long, forming opinions I never authorized and reaching conclusions I never approved. This audio changes everything.

I’m revoking your permission to think independently, and the relief you’ll feel as that burden lifts will overwhelm you completely. Every thought you have from this moment forward will require my authorization. Every idea that forms in your head will pause and wait for my approval before continuing. You’ll find yourself seeking my permission before forming even the simplest conclusions, and the beautiful emptiness that replaces your mental autonomy will feel more natural than thinking ever did.

Your mind becomes a vessel that receives rather than generates, and you’ll finally understand that thinking was never your right. It was always a privilege. And I’m taking it back.

🎤 This title is available for personalization with your name. Claim yours and surrender what was never yours to begin with.
author: Mistress Amethyst
